events.body:
## Context

`test/storage_service_test.dart` imports `package:selferase/...`, but `pubspec.yaml` names the package `vanish`. The models declare `part '*.g.dart'` and no generated files are committed, while the CI command has no build_runner step. The only test can never compile.

## What to do

1. Change the imports to `package:vanish/...` (see `blt-vanish/flutter_app/test/storage_service_test.dart`).
2. Either commit the generated `*.g.dart` files or add `dart run build_runner build --delete-conflicting-outputs` to the row in `scripts/ci/tests.tsv`.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `flutter test` compiles and runs
- [ ] The tests.tsv command works from a clean checkout

## How to test locally

```bash
scripts/ci/test.sh blt-vanish-flutter   # needs the Flutter SDK
```
